# Initial Data

```{r}
old_data <- fromJSON("migration-data/migration-data.json")

# bd_data <- old_data |> as_tibble()
```

## Looking through structure
```{r}
class(old_data)
typeof(old_data)
length(old_data)
names(old_data)
```

```{r}
sapply(old_data, class)
```

```{r}
# Count records in each df
old_data |> 
  keep(is.data.frame) |> 
  map_int(nrow)
```
```{r}

```


```{r}
# Count records in each list
old_data |> 
  keep(~ is.list(.x) && !is.data.frame(.x)) |> 
  map(names)
```

```{r}
old_data |> 
  pluck("aceptaciones")
```


# Volunteers
```{r}
old_data$vols

# Check duplicates
old_data$vols |> 
  count(id) |> 
  filter(n > 1)
```

# Confirmations
```{r}
names(old_data$confirm)

old_data$confirm |> 
  unnest(cols = dias)

# Check duplicates
old_data$confirm |> 
  # unnest(cols = dias) |> 
  count(volId, semana, bloque) |> 
  filter(n > 1)
```
